st: The singularity seems near: Gemini 3 lets you build anything with a few prompts, from study apps to multiplayer games.

sec.t: ff.141.1 Feeling useless in the AI era
sec.p: From ff.44 'Such anxiety!' to 2025: anxiety grows with generative worlds running parallel to classic social media (Instagram, LinkedIn). A historical comparison: in the 1700s you trained for twenty years to plough fields, then the industrial revolution arrived — today the same…

sec.t: ff.141.2 Slowing down when lions are chasing you
sec.p: Boyd Varty runs personal-growth experiences in the Londolozi nature reserve (South Africa), among lions and a primal setting. Tim Ferriss interviews him: 'When a project is working, divest and let it run — energetic jiu-jitsu on things'. Counter-intuitive: slow down precisely…

Oliver Burkeman suggests a Done List instead of a To-Do List: write down the satisfying things you did this year. Dan Harris (Daily-ish): allow yourself to skip a day of your obsessive routines. Jack King, a priest in Tennessee, calls for 'scruffy' hospitality: welcoming people…
